answer_1.quote: We assess model performance on general knowledge, mathematical problem-solving, code generation and commonsense reasoning benchmarks.
answer_1.outputs: instruction-following responses, code, mathematical reasoning, commonsense reasoning

answer_2.quote: Evaluation is conducted using Open-Compass , with vLLM  for acceleration.

answer_3.quote: To reduce manual annotation costs, many approaches use the LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm . To achieve this, instead of relying on an external judge, we leverage the fine-tuned model itself to assess data quality via Self-alignment Scores, effectively incorporating the model's own feedback.
